basis: Actual exported GLBs, original embedded PBR. Corrected fox front/back reviewed under studio08 CPU Cycles; selected native 2K studio09 wide/detail/rear previews reviewed. Final video render in progress.

fox_knight.assessment: Actual normal-preserving UltraTex repaint: readable face, quilted seams, leather and metal. Back head/tail geometry remains layered and fur too glossy; no texture engine can correct this geometry.

clockwork_owl.assessment: Readable layered metal plates, leather bag, teal enamel and gold detailing on front and back. Some reflections are strong and the painter shifts the reference toward aged metal.

observatory.generation: 1024, 4K atlas; export normals corrected without changing material pixels
observatory.assessment: Stone, copper and blue-green roof surfaces remain separated. Window/arch geometry is softened; not an architectural reconstruction guarantee.

explorer_chest.generation: 1024, 4K atlas; new full image pipeline on corrected native UV mapping
explorer_chest.assessment: Wood, leather straps, metal trim and front gem remain separated; rear layout is coherent. Small holes and nonmanifold geometry remain. Decorative glyphs are invented, not reliable text.

scope: Subjective review of these examples, not a universal model leaderboard.

fixed_painter_review.scope: Earlier fox comparisons are historical and were not used as a universal ranking. Final showcase selection is example-specific; all three painters have new raw-NORMAL-preserving real inference evidence.

superseded_fox_review: Earlier fox reviews and ranking used an output whose authored normals were stripped. Retained as historical observation, superseded for final selection until new repaint is inspected.
cinema_backdrop_fix: Fixed camera-relative cyclorama; previously occluded rear previews rejected and regenerated.
